# vendor/ — localized frontend dependencies (offline / intranet friendly)

Frontend third-party libraries are now pinned through npm and either bundled
by Vite or compiled at build time; the runtime does not depend on any CDN and
no longer loads classic vendor scripts.

Tailwind CSS 3.4.17 moved from the Play CDN runtime to a PostCSS build-time
dependency in 2026-09. Startup no longer downloads, parses and executes the
407 KB runtime compiler, and styles are no longer generated by scanning the DOM
in the browser. `tailwind.config.cjs` pins the source scan scope and
`darkMode: 'class'`; `tests/compat_audit.test.mjs` verifies the physical
`inset-*` property output that Safari 14.0 needs.

marked and DOMPurify have also moved to npm dependencies, transpiled by Vite for
the Safari 14 target. If a classic script that must load before the application
modules is ever needed again, register its version, SHA-256, license and
purpose in this file; `tests/vendor_asset_integrity.test.js` rejects
unregistered `.js` files.

See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` in the repository root for full third-party
attribution.
